title: BetterClans
description: BetterClans is a specialized plugin that enhances and streamlines clan management for players, offering an intuitive interface and advanced features for a superior clan experience.
body:
# 🛡️ BetterClans
### 👑 The Ultimate Clan Management Plugin for Minecraft

> **BetterClans** is a high-performance, feature-rich solution built for servers that want a competitive and organized social system. From simple team-ups to massive clan wars, this plugin provides everything you need to build a thriving community. **Stop using basic team plugins — upgrade to BetterClans!** 🚀

---

## ✨ Features

⚔️ **Clan Wars**
Engage in organized battles! Challenge rival clans to structured fights and prove who is the dominant force on the server.

🤝 **Advanced Diplomacy**
Define your relations. Set other clans as **Allies**, **Rivals**, or keep it **Neutral**. Integrated chat tags show exactly who is friend or foe.

💰 **Shared Clan Bank**
Pool your resources! Members can deposit money into a shared vault to fund clan upgrades, land claims, or special perks.

🏠 **Clan Homes & Waypoints**
Never get lost. Set shared clan homes (`/clan home`) so your members can regroup instantly during raids or events.

📊 **Dynamic Leaderboards**
Track everything. From K/D ratios to total wealth, our leaderboard system keeps the competition alive and rewarding.

---

## 🏆 Why Choose BetterClans?

| ✅ Feature | 💬 Benefit |
|---|---|
| **Optimized Code** | Zero lag, even with hundreds of active clans |
| **SQL/MySQL Support** | Reliable data storage for large networks |
| **PlaceholderAPI** | Show clan tags in Tab, Chat, and Scoreboards |
| **Customizable** | 100% of messages and settings can be changed |
| **Member Roles** | Assign Leaders, Coleaders, and Members |

---

## 🎮 Perfect For

- 🏹 **Survival & SMP** - Create communities and protect your lands.
- 🏰 **Factions & RPG** - Build empires and manage complex diplomacy.
- ⚔️ **Competitive PvP** - Track stats and dominate the clan rankings.

---

## 📊 Plugin Info

- ⚡ **Performance:** Ultra-lightweight & async processing
- 🎮 **Version:** 1.16 — 1.21+
- 🔄 **Compatibility:** Works with Vault, WorldGuard, and Essentials
- 💾 **Storage:** SQLite (default) or MySQL

---

*Built with ❤️ for the Minecraft community — BetterClans* 🛡️🔥
